correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Zak transform as e^{-λx}F_{c+x}(r e^{2πiω}), F_u rational from cubic geometric moments. Verified symbolic numerator identity F_u(-r)=P_r(u)/(1+r)^4, exact Cayley transform F_u=(1+w)H_u(y), cubic discriminant −12E(u), and Routh–Hurwitz determinant 6u(u−1)(2u−1). Root signs show any zero inside unit disc must lie on negative real z, so only ω=1/2 can vanish. P_r derivative and values at 0,1 give the r0=2−√3 root-count transition; shifted-series identity shows u_+−u_-<1, covering the parameter intervals. At c=u_+, the sole boundary Zak zero has nonzero real and frequency derivatives, with local minimum in ω and monotonic increase away from c boundary, while compactness rules out other global minima. Squaring P_r/(1+r)^4 gives exact boundary lower bound and leading 9(v_+²−r)²/(1+r)^6 δ². Independent sympy exact identities plus source finite checker inspection corroborate; no finite Zak grid is used as a universal proof.
